R1.reproduction: Three batches of eight speakers whose REST user requests never settle, production timing, 5.3 s between batches. R1.inSuiteTest: discord-bot.receive.test.ts: 'with the production timing, three batches of eight unidentified speakers never have more than eight REST requests unsettled (24 before)' failed on aff685a with 'requests started (24)'; passes after.
R1.secondTestOnBefore: 'a slot is released only when its REST request settles...' also failed on aff685a, but only because it uses the identityLookup timing option that the fix adds (API red, not behavioural).
